index.summary: Configuration scaffolding capabilities (--clix-init and --clix-template) for generating standard JSON and INI companion configuration templates.

product.objective: Provide scaffolding capabilities (--clix-init and --clix-template) in DogdouClix to quickly generate and output standard .clix.json and .clix.ini companion configuration templates with full schema structure, context defaults, and comments.

index.summary: Core template generators for JSON and INI formats in ConfigParser.

deliverable.description: ConfigParser programmatic methods to generate valid JSON and INI configuration templates and write them to disk safely.

index.summary: CLI interface for --clix-init and --clix-template in Forwarder.

deliverable.description: CLI command handling in Forwarder to generate configuration files (--clix-init) or write templates directly to stdout (--clix-template).

index.summary: Unit and integration test coverage for template emission and CLI execution.

deliverable.description: Automated test suite verifying template validity, file generation, roundtrip parsing, and CLI flag handling.

index.summary: User documentation and usage guides for scaffolding commands.

deliverable.description: Documentation updates in USAGE_GUIDE.md, README.md, and help text.

included.item: JSON configuration template generation with schema, target, cwd, desktop, user, env_set, and env_remove.
INI configuration template generation with structured sections and comments.
Unit and integration tests for template generation, file writing, and parsing.
Documentation updates in USAGE_GUIDE.md, README.md, and help text.

excluded.item: Interactive wizard prompts for individual config fields.

requirement.statement: ConfigParser must provide programmatic methods to generate valid JSON and INI configuration templates and write them to disk safely.
requirement.rationale: Enables reliable generation of standard configuration templates across CLI and library consumers.

requirement.statement: dogdouclix CLI must support --clix-init to generate configuration files and --clix-template to output templates to stdout.
requirement.rationale: Allows developers to quickly scaffold companion configuration files or pipe templates to scripts.

acceptance.criterion: Generated JSON and INI templates are syntactically valid and parse cleanly through ConfigParser.
CLI commands --clix-init and --clix-template correctly emit templates to file or stdout.
